name: Bendigo's.Net
summary: Bendigo ISP of Bendigo Web Central (bwc.com.au, ~2002); defunct (VICTOR, MARK SHANE (sole trader), ABN 53 142 565 150).

events.details: Defunct. Proposal (== current) 'by Jul 2007' promoted: hard evidence shows guide-mode by Jun 2003 and a still-listed ISP brand in Jul 2007; applies to the ISP brand/service, not the domain. bwc.com.au running as 'Bendigo Web Central' city guide; guide-mode on record since at least Jun 2003; still listing 'Bendigos.Net - ISP' Jul 2007.

refs.label: City-guide content on the domain as early as 21 Jun 2003 — the ISP-to-guide transition substantially predates 2007
Live check 29 Sep 2026: even the city guide has since closed
